suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: Flu shot (self-pay price; the plan may pay)
suggested_services.example: The main story: Alex's flu shot and first shingles shot with Leo, billed to Alex's health and drug plans, so nothing is due. Nothing is taken when booking. A share a plan leaves, a self-pay price ($45 for the flu shot, $230 a shingles dose) and a medicine review ($45, or nothing when the drug plan includes it) are all paid at the counter.

suggested_services.name: Flu shot at home (self-pay price; the plan may pay)
suggested_services.example: The main story: Priya's home visit for Alex's flu shot and COVID-19 shot. Nothing is taken. The pharmacy bills Alex's plan its own way, often with nothing for Alex to pay.

suggested_services.name: Flu and COVID-19 shots at home
suggested_services.example: The same home visit, paid by Alex: nothing is taken, and Rosie texts the $245 bill (flu $45, COVID-19 $160, home visit $40) when Priya texts DONE.

before_times: which shots, or a medicine review: the pharmacy's own list only
for a shot in a series, like shingles: first or second dose
the patient's age group, since the state's age rules and some shot kinds depend on it
a health plan, a drug plan (names only), or self-pay
for a video review: which state the patient will be in
who the shots are for: the person booking, a child, or another adult
after_time: anything the pharmacy should know to help, like needing an interpreter or a step-free door
the name and mobile of the person booking
secure_page_only: the patient's legal name, birth date and home address
each plan's member ID and a photo of each plan card

the screening questions: feeling sick today, allergies (to food, latex or a past shot), any past reaction to a shot, fainting with shots, pregnancy or a chance of it, a weakened immune system or treatment that weakens it, recent shots
for a medicine review: the list of medicines, which stays only on the page
a prescriber's order, where the state's form says this shot needs one
the consent, the privacy notice and the vaccine information sheet for each shot to read ahead
'I'm 18 or older, booking for myself', or how the person booking is related to the patient
the OK to texts and email
intake_questions.never_asked: health details, reactions, medicines and symptoms are never asked or typed in the AI chat: only on the secure page
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult books for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for a child, only from the youngest age the state's form allows for that shot (a switch); another adult (a grown child, a caregiver) only with the patient's own OK on the secure page, or as the patient's guardian or health care agent; someone under 18 never books alone
intake_questions.who_may_bring: a parent or legal guardian brings a child and stays for the whole visit and the wait; another adult brings a child only with the parent's signed OK on the secure page, where the state's rules allow it; an adult patient may bring anyone they like

stop.words: signs of a severe allergic reaction: trouble breathing, swelling of the face, lips or throat, hives spreading fast, or fainting after a shot
stop.say: Call 911 now. If you have an epinephrine pen, use it. Don't wait for a booking.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words in a later text get 911 again, and any visit stays booked until the pharmacy calls

stop.words: chest pain, signs of a stroke (a drooping face, a weak arm, slurred speech, a sudden severe headache), or very heavy bleeding
stop.say: Call 911 or go to the emergency room now. Don't wait for a booking.

stop.words: an overdose, or swallowed medicine or a chemical
stop.say: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222. If the person isn't breathing or won't wake up, call 911.

go_on.words: someone who feels a little unwell and wants a shot
go_on.what: booked as asked; the screening questions ask about feeling sick, and only the pharmacist decides on the day if the shot should wait

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about suicide or self-harm get 988

steps.name: The screening questions and the consent
steps.when: on the secure page while booking, within the saved time, never by text; a booking the pharmacy makes by phone or at the counter: due the day before, at an hour the pharmacy sets, with one reminder
steps.who: every patient, for every shot visit
steps.result: a pharmacist reads the answers the working day before; answers not in: the patient answers on the secure page at the counter, and the pharmacist reads them before any shot

steps.name: The pharmacist's review of the answers
steps.when: the working day before the visit
steps.result: nothing stands out; or the pharmacist calls the patient first; or a shot isn't right at a pharmacy, and the visit is cancelled with nothing charged

steps.name: The vaccine count
steps.when: before any time is offered, and again when the visit is booked
steps.result: in stock: the doses are set aside for the visit; out of stock: only times after the next delivery are offered

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the pharmacy, by hand or by a trial claim; checked again the working day before
steps.who: every patient who names a plan
steps.result: covered, some shots only, not covered, or can't check now (the pharmacy checks later, and the patient may cancel free)

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay patients
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day (the example pharmacy's rule), or sooner where the rules require it
steps.result: a to-do for the pharmacy, with its due date

steps.name: A prescriber's order
steps.when: before the visit, only for a shot the state's form says needs one
steps.result: a to-do for the pharmacy; not on file by the visit: that shot waits, with no fee

first_steps_and_forms.prep: bring a photo ID and each plan card; wear a short-sleeved or loose top; eat something first if shots make you light-headed; plan to stay 15 minutes after the shot; at home: have the plan cards ready and a chair to sit in

staff.skills: pharmacists: shots, medicine reviews, home shot visits and shot clinics; only people cleared for home visits go to homes; trained technicians or interns give shots only where the state's form allows it, under a pharmacist (a switch)
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each pharmacist's own license, per state, plus any vaccine training certificate the state's form asks for
staff.supervision: a technician or intern who gives shots works under a pharmacist on site, where the state's form allows it at all
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs a shot clinic's date and host, a home visit on a day nobody is cleared for, and anything a pharmacist flags
staff.stand_in: a pharmacist out: another pharmacist may take the visit, with the patient's yes; nobody is moved without it

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult books for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for a child, only from the youngest age the state's form allows for that shot (a switch); another adult (a grown child, a caregiver) only with the patient's own OK on the secure page, or as the patient's guardian or health care agent; someone under 18 never books alone
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts about a child go to the parent or guardian, never to the child

visit.check_in: at the pharmacy: the check-in code at the counter, then the pharmacist checks the photo ID and the plan cards against the secure page; a video review: the code read out at the start; at home: the code from the patient at the door
visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the shots, lot numbers and any reaction go in the pharmacy's own records, never in Rosie or a text
visit.changes_at_visit: another shot is added only with the patient's yes, if it's in stock and the screening answers cover it, with any self-pay price first; a shot waits for another day if the patient is sick or the pharmacist says so
visit.before_work: the pharmacist goes over the screening answers with the patient, asks how they feel today, and gives the vaccine information sheet for each shot before it's given

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always: each pharmacist holds their own active license from the state where the patient is during the visit; the pharmacy holds the state's pharmacy permit; whether a pharmacist needs extra vaccine training or a certificate, and whether trained technicians or interns may give shots, comes from the state's form (a switch)
license.ask: each pharmacist's license number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); the pharmacy's permit number from the owner; each person's vaccine training certificate where the state's form asks for one
license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks for it

never_in_a_text: texts carry only the pharmacy's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never a shot's name, a medicine, a screening answer, a reaction or a health detail
languages: English and Spanish; the secure page asks if the patient needs an interpreter, and the pharmacy is told
